name: chatgpt-pro-bridge
description: Send prompts through signed-in ChatGPT Pro and archive complete responses without returning their bodies to the agent context.

interface.shortDescription: Archive ChatGPT Pro responses outside agent context.
interface.longDescription: Uses a fresh isolated monitoring worker for every ChatGPT Pro bridge request from a subagent-capable main agent, so the main agent never owns the browser or output-checking loop. The worker starts a new chat, attaches images through verified clipboard paste, sends the complete-context envelope, archives separate metadata, request, and response-only files, and returns only paths, counts, hashes, and verification status.
interface.defaultPrompt: Send this prompt through signed-in ChatGPT Pro using one fresh dedicated monitoring worker, archive the complete response in zero-body mode, and return only its path, count, hash, and verification status.
